summary: The device online event is received by AccessManager::OnDeviceOnline but fails to reach the enable flow. The most likely root cause is a race condition in DistributedHardwareManagerFactory where flagUnInit_ is set to true during offline processing (when no real-time online devices remain) and is not properly reset before the next online event arrives. The flagUnInit_ guard at SendOnLineEvent:185 blocks the online event, returning ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED without creating an OnLineTask. A secondary likely contributor is that the isInit_ re-initialization at SendOnLineEvent:200-203 can also fail if UnInit is still in progress (releaseProcessMutex_ held), or the IsDeviceOnline duplicate check at line 190 can swallow the re-online event if the previous offline did not fully clean up DHContext device records.

hypotheses.title: flagUnInit_ guard blocks online event after offline sets it to true
hypotheses.evidence_summary: SendOffLineEvent sets flagUnInit_=true at line 246 when GetRealTimeOnlineDeviceCount()==0. SendOnLineEvent checks flagUnInit_ at line 185 and returns early with ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED. In a reconnection scenario where the last device goes offline then comes back online, flagUnInit_ may still be true when the online callback fires, blocking the entire enable chain.

hypotheses.title: IsDeviceOnline duplicate check swallows re-online event
hypotheses.evidence_summary: SendOnLineEvent checks DHContext::IsDeviceOnline(uuid) at line 190 and returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_DEVICE_REPEAT_ONLINE if true. The offline path calls DeleteRealTimeOnlineDeviceNetworkId but does NOT call RemoveOnlineDeviceIdEntryByNetworkId (the broader online device set), so the device may still appear online in DHContext, causing the re-online to be silently dropped.

hypotheses.title: isInit_==false forces re-Init which may fail during UnInit release
hypotheses.evidence_summary: SendOnLineEvent at line 200-203 checks isInit_ and calls Init() if false. UnInit at line 117 sets isInit_=false. If UnInit is still in progress (holding releaseProcessMutex_), the Init() call inside SendOnLineEvent may fail or deadlock, preventing the online flow.

hypotheses.title: OnLineTask::CreateEnableTask finds no capabilities
hypotheses.status: Ruled out as root cause but possible contributor
hypotheses.evidence_summary: CreateEnableTask looks up capabilities from CapabilityInfoManager, LocalCapabilityInfoManager, and MetaInfoManager. If DoSyncInfo fails or data is not synced, capabilities may be empty, causing CreateEnableTask to return without creating enable tasks. However, this would produce a warning log, not silently fail at the online entry point.

hypotheses.title: CheckDemandStart/CheckSinkConfigStart rejects auto-enable
hypotheses.evidence_summary: EnableTask::DoAutoEnable calls CheckDemandStart/CheckSinkConfigStart which check version and feature compatibility. If the remote version info is not available (meta info not synced), CheckDemandStart returns ERR_DH_FWK_COMPONENT_COMPVERSION_NOT_FOUND, preventing source enable.

findings.title: flagUnInit_ race condition blocks device re-online enable flow
findings.causal_chain: Last device goes offline -> SendOffLineEvent sets flagUnInit_=true (line 246) when GetRealTimeOnlineDeviceCount==0 -> Device comes back online -> AccessManager::OnDeviceOnline -> SendOnLineEvent checks flagUnInit_.load() (line 185) which is still true -> returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED without creating OnLineTask -> enable flow never executes
evidence: distributed_hardware_manager_factory.cpp:246 sets flagUnInit_.store(true) in SendOffLineEvent when GetRealTimeOnlineDeviceCount()==0
distributed_hardware_manager_factory.cpp:185-188 checks if (flagUnInit_.load()) and returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED
flagUnInit_ is only reset to false in UnInit() at line 118 and in the Init() method indirectly via isAllInit_
There is no explicit path that resets flagUnInit_ to false when a new device comes online BEFORE the online event is processed
The UnInit path at line 117 sets isInit_=false, and Init() sets isInit_=true but flagUnInit_ is only reset at line 118 inside UnInit which may have already completed
findings.affected_scope: All device reconnection scenarios where the device was the last online device before going offline
findings.impact: Device re-online is completely blocked from triggering enable, breaking distributed communication after reconnection
findings.verification: Add logging at SendOnLineEvent:185-188 to confirm flagUnInit_ is true when the online event is received in a reconnection scenario. Alternatively, check if UnInit has been called between offline and online events.

findings.title: DHContext online device set not cleaned during offline, causing IsDeviceOnline duplicate check to block re-online
findings.causal_chain: Device goes offline -> SendOffLineEvent calls DeleteRealTimeOnlineDeviceNetworkId but NOT RemoveOnlineDeviceIdEntryByNetworkId -> Device comes back online -> SendOnLineEvent checks IsDeviceOnline(uuid) which checks devIdEntrySet_ -> finds device still in set (because Remove was not called) -> returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_DEVICE_REPEAT_ONLINE -> online event silently dropped
evidence: SendOffLineEvent at line 243 calls DeleteRealTimeOnlineDeviceNetworkId but does NOT call RemoveOnlineDeviceIdEntryByNetworkId on the devIdEntrySet_
SendOnLineEvent at line 190 checks DHContext::IsDeviceOnline(uuid) which searches devIdEntrySet_
IsDeviceOnline returning true causes SendOnLineEvent to return ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_DEVICE_REPEAT_ONLINE at line 192
The AddOnlineDevice at line 195 inserts into devIdEntrySet_, but RemoveOnlineDeviceIdEntryByNetworkId is not called in the offline path
findings.affected_scope: Device reconnection where the offline path does not fully clean up DHContext device tracking
findings.impact: Re-online events may be treated as duplicate online and silently dropped
findings.verification: Check if RemoveOnlineDeviceIdEntryByNetworkId is called during the offline flow. Trace DHContext::devIdEntrySet_ contents during a reconnection scenario.

findings.title: isInit_ re-initialization in SendOnLineEvent may race with UnInit release process
findings.causal_chain: Device goes offline -> UnInit called -> sets isInit_=false, acquires releaseProcessMutex_ -> Device comes back online -> SendOnLineEvent checks isInit_==false (line 200) -> calls Init() -> Init() may fail if subsystem managers are not ready or if release is still in progress -> SendOnLineEvent returns ERR_DH_FWK_HARDWARE_MANAGER_INIT_FAILED
evidence: distributed_hardware_manager_factory.cpp:200-203 checks !isInit_.load() && !Init() and returns error
UnInit at line 105 acquires releaseProcessMutex_ and at line 117 sets isInit_=false
Init at line 84-99 calls DistributedHardwareManager::Initialize() which may fail if subsystems are not ready
The race between UnInit release and new online event Init is not protected by a common mutex
findings.affected_scope: Reconnection scenarios where the system is transitioning between initialized and uninitialized states
findings.impact: Online event processing fails because re-initialization cannot complete
findings.verification: Add logging around Init() call in SendOnLineEvent to check if it returns failure. Check timing between UnInit completion and online event arrival.

findings.title: OnLineTask::CreateEnableTask finds no capability data after reconnection
findings.causal_chain: Device goes offline -> ClearRemoteDeviceMetaInfoData/ClearRemoteDeviceLocalInfoData called for double-frame devices -> Device comes back online -> OnLineTask::DoSyncInfo syncs data from DB -> If DB sync is slow or fails, capability info is empty -> CreateEnableTask finds no capabilities -> returns without creating EnableTask -> enable flow never executes
evidence: online_task.cpp:126-152 shows CreateEnableTask checks CapabilityInfoManager, LocalCapabilityInfoManager, and MetaInfoManager in sequence
If all three return empty, CreateEnableTask returns without creating enable tasks (line 148-152)

SendOnLineEvent at line 215-217 calls ClearRemoteDeviceMetaInfoData and ClearRemoteDeviceLocalInfoData for double-frame devices (osType == -1 or 11), which may clear data that has not yet been re-synced
findings.affected_scope: Double-frame device reconnection where capability data is cleared before being re-synced
findings.impact: Enable tasks are not created because capability data is not available
findings.verification: Check if CreateEnableTask logs 'Can not get cap info' during reconnection. Verify that DoSyncInfo successfully syncs data before CreateEnableTask runs.

findings.title: CheckDemandStart fails because remote version info is unavailable after reconnection
findings.causal_chain: Device comes back online -> OnLineTask creates EnableTask -> EnableTask::DoAutoEnable calls CheckDemandStart -> CheckDemandStart calls GetRemoteVerInfo -> MetaInfoManager has no data for the remote device yet -> returns ERR_DH_FWK_COMPONENT_COMPVERSION_NOT_FOUND -> DoAutoEnable returns error -> enable fails
evidence: enable_task.cpp:203-208 calls CheckDemandStart and returns its error code if it fails
component_manager.cpp:1134-1145 CheckDemandStart calls GetRemoteVerInfo which searches MetaInfoManager
If meta info has not been synced yet, GetRemoteVerInfo returns ERR_DH_FWK_COMPONENT_COMPVERSION_NOT_FOUND
The online task runs DoSyncInfo before CreateEnableTask, but the sync may not complete before the enable task runs
findings.affected_scope: Reconnection scenarios where meta info data sync has not completed before enable task runs
findings.impact: Auto-enable fails because remote version compatibility cannot be determined
findings.verification: Check if CheckDemandStart logs 'GetRemoteVerInfo fail' during reconnection. Verify the ordering of DoSyncInfo and CreateEnableTask execution.
